recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future broad rewrite of Condition/Observation symptom boundaries should be handled under a final later Patient Care Jira rather than changing the already-applied FHIR-15970 resolution.
issue_request: FHIR-15970 was a Published Patient Care STU3 change request, resolved Not Persuasive with Modification, asking to remove allegedly ambiguous Condition guidance about symptoms. The final resolution kept the boundary guidance and approved adding the example that headache may be captured as an Observation when it contributes to establishing a meningitis Condition.
initial_application: The issue was applied before this reconciliation in commit 722ed5c93f4bc9828e96f0f5b476bedc3486fb92, whose subject includes "GF#15970 - clarify Condition boundaries" and whose patch added the approved headache-as-Observation contrast sentence to source/condition/condition-introduction.xml.
additional_context: Condition is an active resource in source/fhir.ini. Later issue FHIR-26904 changed the same paragraph by adding the inpatient nursing-problem example and Condition-instance clarification; it is already represented on the combined branch by audit commit 978120d71d98417997638bded73f4313a41d256a and preserves the FHIR-15970 wording. FHIR-56690 is a newer Submitted/Unresolved proposal and is not a final source-edit decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Condition introduction already retains the WG-approved Observation-vs-Condition symptom guidance and includes the exact FHIR-15970 contrast example, so removing or rewriting that prose would contradict the Published resolution.
